name: Skaven

factionAbilities.name: The Lurking Vermintide
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that has not been deployed.
factionAbilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the tunnels below. It has now been deployed.

factionAbilities.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
factionAbilities.flavour: The best laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-MONSTER SKAVEN unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.
factionAbilities.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

factionAbilities.name: Too Quick to Hit-Hit
factionAbilities.flavour: These skittish ratmen dart and run in all directions, avoiding retribution as they flee from combat.
factionAbilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY and CAVALRY units by RETREAT abilities.

factionAbilities.name: Splinters of the Vermindoom
factionAbilities.flavour: In the aftermath of the Vermindoom, reality continues to fracture and tear as gnawholes bore into reality, spewing forth endless tides of ratmen.
factionAbilities.declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly Gnawholes on the battlefield.
factionAbilities.effect: Set up a Gnawhole on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

factionAbilities.name: Gnawhole Ambush
factionAbilities.flavour: Emerging from a green, glowing rift, the Skaventide pours onto the battlefield.
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability.
factionAbilities.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Gnawhole and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Corrupted Earth
abilities.flavour: The Clans Pestilens are relentless in advancing the spread of plague and corruption.
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly PESTILENS units that are in combat to be the targets.

list: Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Prized Creations
abilities.flavour: Moulder warbeasts are studded with warpstone crystals and pumped full of vile serums that spur their battle-rage – at the occasional cost of overtaxing their forms.
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-HERO MOULDER units to be the targets.
effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

table.text: Self-destructive Fury: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
Rabid Infusion: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
Blinded by Frenzy: In addition to the effect of 'Rabid Infusion', the target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Claw-picked
abilities.flavour: The Stormvermin and Clanrats of a Verminus Claw-horde are amongst the most ferocious of all ratmen.
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly VERMINUS units that charged this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Skryre Prototypes
abilities.flavour: The fell contraptions wielded by these ratmen were created by the Clans Skryre's most ingenious weaponsmiths.
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly SKRYRE units to be the targets.
effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

table.text: Kaboom!: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
More Power!: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
More-more Power!: In addition to the effect of 'More Power!', add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Kill-Kill! Scurry-Flee!
abilities.flavour: A kill-pack has one purpose: slay the target. Once this goal has been achieved and the element of surprise lost, the Eshin agents must see to their own survival…
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy HERO to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly ESHIN units.

heroicTraits.name: Masterclan Connections
heroicTraits.flavour: This Skaven’s obsequious nature has allowed them to curry favour with a member of the sorcerous Masterclan.

timing.reaction: You declared a SPELL or UNBIND ability for a visible Skaven unit wholly within 13" of this unit

heroicTraits.effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.

heroicTraits.name: Master of the Swarm
heroicTraits.flavour: This warlord understands the importance of numbers, ensuring their burrows are teeming with fresh warriors.
heroicTraits.effect: Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly SKAVEN unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

heroicTraits.name: Essence of the Gnaw
heroicTraits.flavour: A cursed combination of warpstone and daemonic power allows this rodent to twist reality.
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another visible SKAVEN unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.
heroicTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST and the target has STRIKE-LAST.

artefactsOfPower.name: Foulhide
artefactsOfPower.flavour: Fashioned from the flensed flesh of Rat Ogors and soaked in cloying alchemical agents, this stinking armour sticks to its wearer like a bloated second skin and regrows as fast as it can be hacked apart.

artefactsOfPower.name: Warpstone Charm
artefactsOfPower.flavour: This foul talisman radiates mutating energy that can be directed at an enemy unit to erode their armour.
artefactsOfPower.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
artefactsOfPower.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

artefactsOfPower.name: Skavenbrew
artefactsOfPower.flavour: This foul concoction, brewed from blood and warpstone, is dispensed to expendable underlings to drive them into a short-lived but devastating killing frenzy.
artefactsOfPower.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
artefactsOfPower.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Skitterleap
abilities.flavour: Vanishing in a puff of foul-smelling smoke, the verminkin reappear elsewhere on the battlefield an eye-blink later.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SKAVEN HERO wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.flavour: The spellcaster hurls a glowing green globe of magical energy at the foe. Anyone touched by the globe starts to shrivel and wither away.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Warpgale
abilities.flavour: Screeching in an unholy tongue, the caster parts the veil of reality and draws a ravening gale of unnatural energies forth.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
